description: This file contains utility functions for managing filter bar state in a dashboard, including data extraction, validation checks, comparison of filter states, and a selector for chart verbose maps.

methods.name: getOnlyExtraFormData
methods.description: Extracts extra form data from a DataMaskStateWithId object, returning an object keyed by each item's id.

methods.name: checkIsMissingRequiredValue
methods.description: Checks if a filter element is missing a required value based on its control settings and current filter state.

methods.name: checkIsValidateError
methods.description: Determines if all data mask entries are free of validation errors.

methods.name: checkIsApplyDisabled
methods.description: Decides if applying the filter should be disabled based on validation, missing required filters, and differences in extra form data.

methods.name: useChartsVerboseMaps
methods.description: React hook that retrieves a map of verbose labels for charts from the Redux store.
